mcp.dialogDescription: Configure an MCP server endpoint to enable tool calling.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Short facts the assistant remembers about you and uses in every chat.
memory.useDescription: Give the assistant your saved memories in every chat.
memory.writeDescription: The assistant can save, update and delete memories when you ask it to, and picks up lasting facts from your chats after they go quiet.
memory.confirmClearDescription: The assistant will forget everything listed here. This cannot be undone.
memory.emptyHint: Tell the assistant “remember …” in a chat to save one.
memory.pinHint: Pinned memories are always given to the assistant; others only when relevant, once there are many.
memory.recentChangesDescription: Changes the assistant made in the last 30 days. Undo any you disagree with.

share.title: Shared Links
share.editDescription: Update the expiration time and refresh the conversation content.

backgroundModel.title: Background model
backgroundModel.description: A cheap model that summarizes chats after they go quiet and picks up lasting facts about the user from them. Leave empty to use the title generation model.

embedding.title: Semantic search
embedding.description: An embedding model lets the assistant find past chats by meaning, not only by keywords. Leave it unset for keyword search only.
embedding.modelHelp: The model must output 1024 dimensions or accept a dimensions setting. Saving sends a test request. Changing the model re-embeds all messages in the background.

systemConfig.promptDescription: Configure chat and translation prompts. Saved changes apply to subsequent requests.
systemConfig.titleDescription: Choose the provider, model and prompt for automatic conversation titles.
systemConfig.modelHelp: Only models from active providers are shown. Select a new model after changing providers.
systemConfig.titleHelp: Describe the title requirements. Conversation content is supplied separately and the output structure is managed by the system.
systemConfig.chatHelp: Optional. Supports {{currentDate}} for the current date.
systemConfig.translateHelp: Supports {{sourceLanguage}}, {{targetLanguage}} and {{text}} for source language, target language and input text.
systemConfig.systemPromptHelp: Instructions sent to the model with every conversation and translation.
systemConfig.chatPromptHelp: {{currentDate}} is replaced with the current date (Singapore time).

errorAlert.title: Error Alerts
errorAlert.description: Notify the administrator via Bark when chat, translation, or title generation fails. Canceled requests do not trigger alerts.
errorAlert.help: Enter the full Bark push URL including the device key, such as https://api.day.app/your-device-key. Official and self-hosted services are supported. Changes take effect immediately after saving. Clear and save to disable alerts. Notifications include the provider, model, and error details. User feedback also uses this address; clearing it disables feedback delivery.

model.noModels: No models yet. Click to add one.

model.generativeUiHelp: Adds the OpenUI component guide to the system prompt so replies can include tables, charts and forms.

notification.description: Manage site-wide notification banners displayed to all users.
notification.dialogDescription: Create a notification banner that will be displayed at the top of the main page.
notification.fillRequired: Please fill in title and content

webSearch.title: Web search
webSearch.description: Choose the search provider for all conversations. In Exa mode, web tools are enabled automatically for models with tool calling.
webSearch.nativeHelp: Use the model provider’s own search. Each model must have native web search enabled in its configuration.
webSearch.exaHelp: Automatically provide web_search and web_fetch to models with tool calling enabled, including OpenAI-compatible models. Search and URL Context options are hidden in the input bar.
webSearch.keyHelp: Stored on the server and masked when displayed. Leave the masked value unchanged to keep the key. Obtain a key at dashboard.exa.ai. Exa must have a key before it can be selected.

topicCheck.title: Topic check
topicCheck.description: Before a message is sent in an existing chat, a TypeSafe decision model judges whether it fits the chat's topic. If it doesn't, the user can ask in a new chat or keep it here.
topicCheck.enabled: Check messages for a topic change
topicCheck.baseUrlHelp: Requests go to {{baseUrl}}/v1/systemone. Change it to use a proxy or a self-hosted gateway.
topicCheck.keyHelp: Stored on the server and masked when shown. Keep the masked value to keep the current key. Get a key at console.typesafe.ai. Saving sends a test request.
topicCheck.thresholdHelp: The user is asked when the model's probability of a topic change is at or above this value (0.5–1). Higher values ask less often. If TypeSafe is slow or fails, the message is sent without asking.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.error: Could not send feedback. Please try again later or ask the administrator to check the Bark settings.
feedback.description: Tell us about a problem or an idea. Administrators will receive it directly.
